speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.maxC: Maximum number of seeds that can be generating at the same time.
Maximum number of seeds that can be generating at the same time while on the Wall Screen.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.maxW:
Stops generating a seed at the set percentage unless it is locked.
Note that it will still wait for WorldPreview to be configured before stopping generation.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.resu:
Whether to resume generating seeds after the queue is filled.
This overrides the Max World Generation % option after the queue capacity is filled.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.chun: Freezes the chunkmap after the set milliseconds. Useful for the "Village Resetting" strategy. Only applies to worlds on the wall that aren't locked.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.useW: Shows a wall of all seeds between resets where you can select seeds to join or reset.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.rese: Cooldown before a preview can be reset, starts when the preview is first rendered.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.show: If enabled, the Game Menu Screen will be rendered on top of previews. Needs to be ON for a run to count as No F3.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.wait: On: wait for the first terrain frame before entering the main area; preparing slots hide loading progress. Off: loading previews may be displayed.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.bypa: Bypasses the Wall Screen and immediately puts you into the next locked seed if possible.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.smar: Trying to play an instance that has not finished loading will instead play a previously locked instance if possible.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.wall: The framerate limit used while on the Wall Screen.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.prev:
The framerate limit used for previews on the Wall Screen.
This is relative to the speed the Wall Screen is actually rendering at. Because of that, this setting might work unexpectedly when setting Wall FPS to Unlimited.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.prep: Builds previews in the background before they start being rendered, allowing for a smoother transition when loading a new preview onto the Wall Screen.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.free: If enabled, locked previews will not be sent any new chunks and their preview will not be updated.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.seed: Sets the thread priority for the SeedQueue Thread which creates seeds to generate.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.serv: Sets the thread priority for seeds generating in the background.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.back:
Sets the amount of Worker Threads for seeds generating in queue while in a world.
搂6It is recommended to not set this value higher than the amount of processors your CPU has, but not lower than the Max Generating Seeds option.
Sets the thread priority for SeedQueue Worker Threads.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.wall:
Sets the amount of Worker Threads for seeds generating in queue while on wall.
搂6It is recommended to not set this value higher than the amount of processors your CPU has, but not lower than the Max Generating Seeds (Wall) option.
Sets the thread priority for Wall Worker Threads.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.chun: Sets the number of Sodium Chunk Update Threads per preview on the Wall Screen.
Sets the thread priority for Sodium Chunk Update Threads on the Wall Screen.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.redu: Hides worlds that have been reset on the Wall Screen or during preview from the world list to avoid lag.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.useW: Launches an extra thread that prints out the main threads stacktrace every 10 seconds to diagnose freezing issues.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.show:
Renders an FPS Graph and a Profiler on top of the Wall Screen.
搂cUse this only for debugging, any runs played with this option enabled will be invalidated!
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.benc: How many resets a benchmark run performs (1-1000). Press B to start, N or Esc to cancel.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.show: Renders an overlay with all the chunkmaps of currently generating seeds.
seedqueue.controls: R / click: play | E / right click: reset | L / middle click: lock | T: reset all | F: focus reset
seedqueue.keys.capture: Hold modifiers, then press key / mouse; Backspace clears, Esc cancels

speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.wall: Chunk radius of previews while the wall is open. Smaller values use much less memory and CPU; 10 is plenty for a thumbnail.
Maximum chunk packets applied to one preview per update while the wall is open. Lower values smooth out frame spikes.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.star: How many integrated servers may start at the same time when the wall opens. Lower values make the first previews show up much sooner because the servers no longer starve each other.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.idle: Framerate for previews of worlds that finished generating and are not hovered. Lower values make the wall much smoother when many worlds are ready; 0 keeps every preview at the normal Preview FPS.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.join: Slides the last frame of the current screen out while the next world's preview slides in when joining or resetting into a world. Turn off if you prefer the plain loading screen.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.prew: While sitting on the title screen, start this many worlds in the background so the wall opens with ready previews instead of waiting for the first servers. 0 disables the preload.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.rows: Number of card rows on the wall.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.colu: Number of card columns on the wall.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.chun: Radius (in chunks) generated and previewed for each queued world. Larger values look further but generate slower.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.chec: Warn before queueing when free memory is low.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.show: Show the advanced options in this screen.
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.keyB: Key bindings used on the wall (edited in the keybindings screen).
speedrunapi.config.seedqueue.option.show: Show the generated/total chunk counter on the cards. Hidden by default.
